summary: Iterates the 104-slot vehicle array (base unk_5EC6D8, stride 18624/0x48C0, ending at byte_7C54D8) and, for each vehicle whose live-state int32 at +0x32C8 equals 2, resolves collision-contact response: computes penetration ratio (per-vehicle float at a1+0x1A3D4 divided by flt_7D108C), consults the short-array contact lookup ShortArrayLookupAndZeroCheck, and on severe contact (ratio > 2.0 or contact flag set) releases AI control via VehicleAIControlFlag(0) and toggles driver visibility (hidden when ratio > 8.0 or |contact value| > 0.75, else shown); otherwise retains AI control via VehicleAIControlFlag(1) and shows the driver. Called from SessionScoringUpdate.

local_names.a1: session/scoring context; source of the per-vehicle contact short array at +0x1A3C0 and the penetration float array at +0x1A3D4
local_names.v2: iteration pointer over the vehicle array, advances by 18624 (0x48C0) bytes each step
local_names.v3: pointer into the penetration float array at a1+0x1A3D4, advances one float per step
local_names.v8: out float from the short-array contact lookup; magnitude > 0.75 contributes to hiding the driver

operations.description: Iterate the vehicle array from base unk_5EC6D8 stepping 18624 (0x48C0) bytes, one vehicle per index, until the running pointer reaches byte_7C54D8 (array end bound)
For each vehicle, test the live-state int32 at array element +0x32C8 (element base + 3250 dwords) == 2; only such vehicles get contact response
Call ShortArrayLookupAndZeroCheck on the contact short array at a1+0x1A3C0 with the current vehicle index, writing an out float to v8
Compute penetration ratio v5 = penetration float at a1+0x1A3D4 (per-vehicle, advanced per step) divided by flt_7D108C
Severe-contact test: penetration ratio > 2.0 OR the short-array contact lookup returned nonzero
On severe contact, call VehicleAIControlFlag(0) to release AI control
Visibility guard within severe contact: ratio > 8.0 OR fabs(v8) > 0.75 selects hiding the driver, else showing
Call SetDriverVisibility(0) to hide the driver when the penetration/contact magnitude is large
Otherwise call SetDriverVisibility(1) to show the driver
On non-severe contact, call VehicleAIControlFlag(1) to retain AI control and SetDriverVisibility(1)
